This project's corpus is the text of the 150 arXiv papers below, chunked into `data/chunks_512.json` and quoted in excerpts by the service. Each paper remains under the license its authors chose on arXiv (fetched 2026-09-24 from arXiv's OAI-PMH interface); this project's MIT license covers its code only. To request removal of a paper, see the README's License section.
